Short, spiky ash-brown hair with a messy texture and straight bangs. Deep amber eyes with a determined, youthful expression. Appears to be in late adolescence with a mature, focused face. A lean, athletic build. Wears a signature light-brown leather gambeson over a cream-colored tunic, paired with dark brown trousers and sturdy leather boots. Carries a signature iron broadsword and a simple leather shoulder strap.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
